title: Speaking — Finding your way
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on finding your way.

questions: What do you like about the room you use most?
Is there a part of your home you rarely use?
How long have you lived in your current home?
What would you put in a room of your own?
Do you ask people for directions or use a map?
Are you good at recognising a place you have visited before?

part2.topic: Describe a time when you helped someone find their way.
points: what the person was looking for
part2.closing: and explain how you knew what information was useful.

questions: How can signs make transport hubs easier for first-time visitors?
What are the risks of depending entirely on digital maps?
How has everyday life connected with finding your way changed for people of different ages?
